Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.17778

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of November 2024).
source_name: Henning Ulfarsson, “BiSC: An algorithm for discovering generalized permutation patterns”, arXiv:2411.17778 (2024).
statement: Under the Robinson–Schensted–Knuth correspondence, a permutation is mapped to a pair of Young tableaux of the same shape. Let $A$ be the set of permutations whose tableaux avoid the Young-diagram shape $(3,2)$, and let the displayed four marked mesh patterns be interpreted in the marked-mesh-pattern sense. **RSK shape-avoidance conjecture.** The permutations whose tableaux under the RSK map avoid the shape $(3,2)$ are precisely the avoiders of the four marked mesh patterns displayed in the source. The claim extends the corresponding hook-shape observation and proposes an explicit pattern-avoidance description for a non-hook Young-tableau shape; no resolution is stated.
title: The marked mesh-pattern characterization of permutations with RSK tableaux avoiding $(3,2)$
